units.titles: Oracle refreshment can fail without notifying, leading to the use of a stale price affecting the fees.
units.known_address_notes: Zokyo Feb-2025 review; finding high-2 is in FeeContract.sol (updateFee() pulls IFeeOracle price and can silently keep a stale price, affecting H1 application fees). Docs page 'FeeContract.sol' publishes only TESTNET deployments - implementation 0x716C2a405A658F96FCe7E7C2eE81C0C718bb3d76, proxy 0xe003BdBa0529ED4E1F2B7f40E4E136904fcaD435 (links go to explorer.testnet.haven1.org). Mainnet FeeContract/FeeOracle addresses are unpublished; code check impossible: rpc.haven1.org Cloudflare 1016, rpc.tes

units.titles: buyHashCore signature check is switched off allowing anyone to buy a hascore
units.known_address_notes: Zenith report (Oct 2025) targets neuronest-solidity @ d451be958fee3e5273074586c8a6f3ebac6a8e94: LumiTownExtension.buyHashCore, CommonExtension, ILaunchpad — a game/economy contract set, not the 2023 community contracts. Report states no chain and no address; Lumiterra's live chain is Ronin (game item ERC-1155 verified there, see P25-0150). Exact deployment of neuronest unpublished.

OtterSec (Aug 2022) assessed the Solana program 'marcopolo-dex' (add_tokens, farm rewards, swap, PDAs); Appendix A names github.com/marcopolo-org/Dex, which now returns 404 (no Anchor.toml, no declare_id). Report gives no program id and no deployment. Program address unpublished; project appears dormant.
